task.problem: The canonical BP-V2 before baseline is RUN-152-003 on the standard Windows x64 aios-renew self-host class. Runtime collected 1581 tests and passed all 1581 in 2340.29 seconds on subject 0e40a6dfdae610dca0144200eaf38bd0a43696a7. Historical profiling and current harness audit show the dominant intrinsic cost is repeated construction of equivalent real-Git repositories and bare remotes across control-plane tests. tests/operator_test_support.py make_repo performs Git init, configuration, baseline commit, bare-upstream creation, remote binding and initial push for each sandbox; test_operator.py alone invokes that helper approximately 187 times, while review transport and unified-state tests also reuse it, and authoring/publication suites maintain additional equivalent local constructors. BP-V2 requires at least 50 percent serial full-suite wall-time reduction without shrinking canonical coverage, weakening real-Git semantics, or introducing parallelism. The exact threshold from RUN-152-003 is therefore 1170.145 seconds.
